samples.question: The six colors have different whole-number speeds from 1 to 9. Every CLUE says its LEFT pair has greater combined speed than its RIGHT pair. On each RACE card, both sides perform two 1-unit jobs in sequence, so a side's time is 1/first speed + 1/second speed. Which race must have its LEFT side finish first for every speed assignment fitting all clues? Answer race-1, race-2, race-3, or race-4.
